## Available models (pi-subagent)
`set_model` and `Agent` require the FULL `provider/id` exactly as written below — the provider prefix is mandatory and a bare model id may be rejected. Copy one of these values verbatim:
- anthropic/claude-opus-4-5 — Claude Opus 4.5 (ctx 200k, reasoning)
- anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5 — Claude Haiku 4.5 (ctx 200k)
- openai/gpt-5.2 (ctx 1M)
- kimi/kimi-k2.5
- moonshot/kimi-k2.5-turbo (ctx 128k)
